da8ebf652ad46ed4.en: Eh pá, Silves: a capital of the Algarve before it was cool, still guarding its laranjas from a castle the colour of a ripe tangerine.
da8ebf652ad46ed4.t: Eh pá, Silves: capital do Algarve antes de estar na moda, ainda a guardar as suas laranjas num castelo da cor de uma tangerina madura.
